title: Apply isolated recovery and restart
objective: Apply isolated recovery and restart. Implement only this observable slice using the frozen schema and port contracts.

acceptance_criteria.description: Quiesce affected descendants, preserve evidence and apply only re-reviewed graph transactions
acceptance_criteria.verification: TASK-025 owned behavior tests and structured handoff evidence

acceptance_criteria.description: Start replacement attempts in new worktrees with lineage-wide budgets and fresh review requirements
acceptance_criteria.verification: TASK-025 failure-case tests and structured handoff evidence

output_contracts: workflows/recovery public behavior described by this task acceptance; use predeclared ports
size_rationale: One component outcome with two bounded acceptance checks; no central registry edits. Split further through isolation review if implementation exceeds this estimate.
out_of_scope: Changing shared contracts without a new prerequisite task
Production provider integration, paid services, remote publication and product-scope changes
handoff_requirements: Exact base/commit and verified changed paths
Actual test command evidence and acceptance mapping
